summary: This Quantum Innovations policy document sets out how productivity and performance are measured for remote employees. It rests on trust and accountability, using department-specific KPIs, quality-focused performance metrics, 360-degree appraisals, regular manager check-ins and technology-based tracking. It balances flexible work hours with accountability for results.
one_line: Quantum Innovations' remote work policy defines KPIs, quality metrics, feedback practices and technology tools for measuring remote employee productivity while keeping flexibility accountable.
key_facts: Quantum Innovations holds that "work is an activity, not a place."
The company's remote work approach is rooted in trust and accountability.
Productivity is measured through key performance indicators (KPIs) tailored to each department and role.
Example productivity KPIs include project completion rates and deadline adherence, quality of work from peer, customer and managerial reviews, and volume of tasks or transactions processed.
Managers work with their teams to set realistic and challenging KPIs aligned with the company's strategic objectives.
Performance metrics emphasize quality over quantity, including customer satisfaction scores, innovation and problem-solving aptitude, and collaboration and communication effectiveness.
Performance appraisals use feedback from a variety of sources to give a 360-degree view of employee contributions.
Consistency is called a cornerstone of remote work, and the policy recognizes and rewards consistent delivery of results across all remote teams.
Managers must conduct regular check-ins to review progress against established metrics and foster continuous feedback.
Quantum Innovations uses technology, from project management tools to analytics platforms, to track, analyze and report on productivity and performance metrics.
The policy allows flexible work hours while maintaining accountability to meet shared goals.
The document serves as a roadmap for employees, managers and leadership teams navigating remote work.
